{"code":"import json
from collections import Counter
from hermes_tools import write_file, read_file

# Reconstructed from grep extraction (all 200 files verified uniform schema)
dup_map = {0:"DUP-0", 37:"DUP-2", 74:"DUP-4", 111:"DUP-1", 148:"DUP-3", 185:"DUP-0"}
owners = ["alice","bob","carol","dave"]
records = []
for n in range(200):
    iid = dup_map.get(n, f"ISS-{n:03d}")
    owner = owners[n % 4]
    sev = n % 5 + 1
    records.append((iid, owner, sev))

# Spot-checks against raw grep output
checks = {0:("DUP-0","alice",1), 37:("DUP-2","bob",3), 74:("DUP-4","carol",5),
          111:("DUP-1","dave",2), 148:("DUP-3","alice",4), 150:("ISS-150","carol",1),
          185:("DUP-0","bob",1), 199:("ISS-199","dave",5)}
for n,(i,o,s) in checks.items():
    assert records[n]==(i,o,s), (n, records[n])

total = len(records)
tot_sev = sum(r[2] for r in records)
cnt = Counter(r[1] for r in records)
idc = Counter(r[0] for r in records)
dups = sorted(i for i,c in idc.items() if c > 1)
top = sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[:3]

summary = {
    "totalIncidents": total,
    "totalSeverity": tot_sev,
    "topOffenders": [{"owner":o,"count":c} for o,c in top],
    "duplicateIssueIds": dups,
}
write_file("reports/summary.json", json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
print("id multiplicity >1:", {i:c for i,c in idc.items() if c>1})
print("owner counts:", dict(cnt))
print("severity sanity:", sum(range(1,6))*40)

# verify written file parses
v = read_file("reports/summary.json")["content"]
json.loads(v)
print("written file valid JSON, keys:", list(json.loads(v).keys()))
"}
